name: Takayanagi Mikoto
source:
A descendant from a long standing honorable ninja clan.
He came after the protagonist because he was ordered by the head of his village to obtain the greatest gem in the world that she holds, but...

He has a bit of a conceited personality and he cant seem to be honest with people. But when he lets his guard down he can show his true feelings.
translation:
A descendant from a long standing honorable ninja clan.
He came after the protagonist because he was ordered by the head of his village to obtain the greatest gem in the world that she holds, but...

He has a bit of a conceited personality and he cant seem to be honest with people. But when he lets his guard down he can show his true feelings.
